attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post, made in his own voice. He is not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: 'Will have sunk' is an unqualified forecast with a fixed deadline, so it is scored. The four named companies and the March 2022 start come from the next paragraph of the same post, so taking them is reasonable. The separate claim about spending next year is correctly left out.

contract.note: The contract says openly that the post does not define 'sunk into generative AI'. It could mean all capital spending or only the generative-AI part, and the contract does not pick one. The result could turn on that choice, which the speaker never made.

output.rationale: The deadline is 2026-12-31, after the 2026-10-28 evaluation date, and the contract sets no early-resolution rule. The evidence packet has no items, so nothing settles the outcome. Under the rules a forecast is not scored before its deadline. The measure of 'sunk into generative AI' is still unclear and would matter at resolution.
